responsibility: Implements the ARC target’s TARGET_CPU_CPP_BUILTINS hook for the C-family front ends. It translates the currently selected ARC CPU, endianness, floating-point mode, TLS register number, LP_COUNT width, and hardware feature flags into predefined preprocessor macros and assertions, largely by walking the macro-condition table in arc-c.def.
same_name_distinction: Provides the executable C-family hook that emits ARC preprocessor builtins at compile time; unlike arc-c.def, it contains the logic that walks the macro table, adds integer-valued builtins such as __ARC_TLS_REGNO__ and __ARC_LPC_WIDTH__, and handles endianness and hard/soft-float defines.
